# Trinity Exteriors

> Roofing contractor in Greenville, South Carolina (formerly Trinity Restoration & Contracting). Roof replacement, roof repair and storm damage insurance claims for homes across the Upstate, plus commercial roofing, gutters, siding, decks and aluminum patio covers.

## Services
- Roofing: roof replacement, new roofs and roof repair: https://trinityext.com/services/roofing
- Commercial roofing: TPO and flat roof repair and replacement: https://trinityext.com/services/commercial-roofing
- Storm damage roofing: hail and wind damage inspections and insurance claim help: https://trinityext.com/services/storm-damage-roofing
- Roof inspection: free roof inspections: https://trinityext.com/services/roof-inspection
- Emergency roof repair and leak repair: https://trinityext.com/services/emergency-roof-repair
- Seamless gutters, siding, fascia and soffit repair
- Deck builder: wood and Trex composite decks: https://trinityext.com/services/deck-builder
- Aluminum patio covers: https://trinityext.com/services/aluminum-patio-covers

## Areas served
Seven Upstate South Carolina counties: Greenville, Spartanburg, Anderson, Pickens, Oconee, Laurens and Greenwood.

- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 106 reviews (October 2026)
- Shingles: mostly Owens Corning Duration; ice and water barrier at eaves, valleys and penetrations as standard
